title: A companion's 'near leaving' state (Lys, regard -2, explicit one-time warning given: 'I only say a thing once') was never resolved either way by game end - she stayed at exactly that threshold through the winning ending with no further check-in, so it's unclear whether another theft would truly have made her leave or whether regard simply floors there.
